docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This script uses the pyvisa library to communicate with external hardware over VISA protocol (e.g., GPIB, USB, RS232). It’s used to query device identity and test connectivity.

docs.title:
This script sets up a Data Acquisition

(DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in Python.

It defines which channels to use, the

timing of the acquisition,

and how the DAQ system starts and

stops. Setup python Copy Edit

import nidaqmx

Import the NI-DAQmx Python library.

python Copy Edit

task = nidaqmx.Task()

Create a new task object to manage DAQ operations.
